subject: HILLS
name: Hills — sunlit tracks and wooded ravines

styleSelection.reason: Loose connected yellow-green slope washes and blue-green tree shadows carry the landscape; restrained sepia gestures explain near trunks and path-side branches.

families.referenceCue: The upper sunlit yellow-green ridge and its narrow pale track recede behind small muted tree masses. Broad transparent value planes; sparse distant detail.
Pale warm path bends down the left grassy slope between dark trees; preserve its narrow connected ribbon and soften only selected hill turns.
Cool blue-green wooded diagonal joins several irregular tree groups; connected shadow glazing across crowns and trunks, leaving grey-green light crowns visible.
The large tree at the foreground path bend has a branching dark trunk and connected irregular crown; fitted wash shapes followed by a few dry sepia branch gestures.
Broad luminous chartreuse meadow crossed by a cream S-shaped path; ground turns are broad value washes, with dark bordering trees and very sparse foreground texture.

reserves.reason: Bare paper glint inside the lower cream track; surrounding track is a pale warm painted plane
Small bare paper glint in the receding upper track
